messages:
Sasha (CS): Heads-up — ParcelPulse shows a ~62% drop in API volume and seats pinging over the past 10 days. New procurement lead Maya Chen started two weeks ago; CTO said they're running a quick bake-off with OptiServe. Seems like a renewal risk. Can we triage?

Tom (Solutions): Looking now. Any 4xx/5xx or auth spikes? looping in @Raj for infra logs.

Raj (Eng): Found clustered 401s and some 502s for org 77654 on 2025-06-12. Proxy samples: `{"org":"77654","status":401,"path":"/v1/chat","err":"invalid_token"}` and `{"org":"77654","status":502,"path":"/v1/generate","err":"upstream_timeout"}`. Also their billing webhook shows a 410.

Tom (Solutions): 410 on billing webhook could auto-disable features on our side — that would explain seat inactivity. Can we confirm if webhook delivery failed?

Integrations Bot: Ticket PP-7711 opened — "ParcelPulse: billing webhook 410; invalid_token; degraded traffic" https://support.redwood/pp/7711

Becca (Sales): Renewal ~40 days out (annual). If Maya is seeing OptiServe results, we need to (1) restore activity quickly and (2) lock in a short evaluation window. I'll prep a commercial cadence.

Sasha (CS): Immediate plan: (A) Outreach: quick async note to Maya offering a 30-min triage call today (Tom + Raj). (B) Tech: confirm webhook endpoint & token; Raj to provide repro and ETA to re-enable billing webhook. (C) Commercial: offer a 3-week performance trial (telemetry review + dedicated burst) — Becca to draft. (D) CRM: tag reasons ["billing_failure","seat_activity_drop","competitive_eval"] and set renewal_flag=at-risk until follow-up.

Raj (Eng): I can re-run delivery attempts and rotate the webhook signing token if needed. ETA 20m. I'll also add a temporary upstream timeout bump to reduce 502s during retries.

Tom (Solutions): Drafting checklist for Maya: (1) confirm billing webhook URL reachable, (2) check webhook secret in their payments system matches dashboard, (3) run `curl` sample and paste response.

Integrations Bot: Linked ticket PP-7711 to CRM account and added label "renewal-risk".

Becca (Sales): Drafting trial terms: "3-week dedicated perf window; telemetry review; complimentary credits for duration." Sending to Legal for fast review.

Sasha (CS): Please paste the usage snapshot (6mo) and update when PP-7711 is resolved and when trial PO is issued. I'll prepare an exec one-pager for CS leadership. :white_check_mark:
